newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian stocks mixed, volume soars.
newsitem.headline: Croatian stocks mixed, volume soars.

text.p: Croatian stocks were mixed on Tuesday with a sharp rise in volume and turnover.
* Of seven active issues three were up, two were down and two flat.
* Volume almost tripled to 11,084 shares, while turnover rose to 11.1 million kuna.
* Most actively traded issue was Zagrebacka Banka, which rose 10 kuna to 990 with 8,000 units sold.
* Biggest loser was hotelier Jadranturist, 5 kuna down to 205 on volume of 178 shares.
* Biggest gainer was Privredna Banka, last traded in September, which rose to 250 from 145 kuna on volume of 100 shares.
